summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amended certificate of designation for its Series A Convertible Preferred Shares. The amendment adjusts the conversion ratio from 10 ordinary shares per preferred share to 2/7 of an ordinary share per preferred share to reflect a previously approved 1-for-35 share consolidation, and corrects the anti-dilution formula. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is announced; this is a routine post-consolidation filing. The filing is a periodic report of a foreign private issuer. No deal terms are applicable.
